newsitem.title: USA: Champion comfortable with Q4 EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: Champion comfortable with Q4 EPS estimates.

text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc's chief executive, Walter Young, said Wednesday he is comfortable with fourth quarter estimates of at least $0.33 per share excluding costs of the Redman Industries Inc merger.
The company also said that its manufactured home shipments in the fourth quarter remain healthy.
"If the fourth quarter, as well as consumer confidence, job creation and interest rates, are indicators of the future, the demand for Champion's homes bodes well for 1997," Young said in a release.
Young said the company remains committed to its three-year goal of at least 20 percent compound annual growth in earnings per share.
